Install the node as an OS service, or uninstall it

Usage: dolos service [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  install    registers `dolos daemon` with this configuration to start at login, or at boot with
             `--system`
  uninstall  stops and unregisters one instance, keeping its configuration and data
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -c, --config <CONFIG>  
  -h, --help             Print help
